title: Houston Holocaust Museum Admission Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This admission ticket offers access to one of the nation’s largest Holocaust museums and one of Houston’s most meaningful cultural institutions. Founded from the vision of Holocaust survivor Siegi Izakson, Holocaust Museum Houston was created to preserve survivor stories, honor those who perished, and educate future generations about the dangers of prejudice and hatred.

Following a major $34 million expansion, the Museum now spans 57,000 square feet and features four permanent galleries, changing exhibition spaces, classrooms, a research library, theater, outdoor amphitheater, and more than 50 interactive screens, mini-theaters, and digital terminals. Fully bilingual in English and Spanish, the Museum provides a powerful, accessible experience designed to inspire reflection, remembrance, and a deeper understanding of the consequences of unchecked hatred.
